violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: smaller ingredient containers next to refrigerated prep units.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: raw pork stored over kimchi and vegetables
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. PIC REARRANGED WALK IN COOLER

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: kimchi made 5 days ago
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. PIC HAD EMPLOYEE LABEL THE KIMCHI WITH A DATE.

out_items.name: Consumer advisory provided for raw and undercooked food

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food, Disclosure
violations.observation: The following raw and/or undercooked foods are provided on the menu, menu board, table tent or brochure without proper disclosure: meats served raw for Korean bbq
violations.corrective_action: The Consumer Advisory shall include a disclosure statement that includes a description of the animal-derived foods as raw/undercooked or identification of the animal-derived foods by asterisking (*) them to a footnote that states that the items are served raw or undercooked, or contain raw or undercooked ingredients.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Poison/Toxic Material, Conditions of Use
violations.observation: Pesticides labeled for residential use were observed in the facility and are being applied by the operator to control pests. OBSERVED A BOTTLE OF RAID IN THE KITCHEN.
violations.corrective_action: Remove residential use pesticides from the facility. When necessary for pest control, chemical pesticides must be applied by a certified pesticide applicator to prevent injury and contamination. PIC DISCARDED THE BOTTLE OF RAID.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: No hand washing soap was at the hand washing sink.
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands. PIC PROVIDED HAND SOAP FOR THE HAND WASHING SOAP.

violations.title: Handwashing Signage
violations.observation: Observed that sign or poster that notifies food employees to wash their hands is not provided or is not clearly visible at all handwashing sinks used by food employees.
violations.corrective_action: Provide a visible sign or poster at all handwashing sinks used by food employees that reminds food employees to wash their hands. PLEASE PROVIDE HAND WASHING SIGNS AT EACH HAND SINK AND AT THE SINKS IN THE BATHROOMS.

out_items.name: Compliance with variance, specialized process, HACCP

violations.title: Variance Requirement, Health Department Determines Need
violations.observation: Specialized processing method of food preservation used for KIMCHI.
violations.corrective_action: A food establishment shall obtain a variance from the Regulatory Authority as specified in 8-103.10 and under 8-103.11 before: 1. smoking food as a method of food preservation rather than as a method for flavor enhancement, 2. curing food, 3. using food additives or adding components such as vinegar, 4. packaging food using a Reduced Oxygen Packaging method, 5. operating a molluscan shellfish life-support system display tank used to store and display shellfish that are offered for human consumption, 6. custom processing animals that are for personal use as food and not for sale or service in a food establishment, 7. preparing food by another method that is determined by the Regularty Authority to require a variance or, 8. sprouting seeds or beans. EHS IS GOING TO PROVIDE MORE INFORMATION VIA EMAIL, ON HOW TO APPLY FOR A HACCP IN ORDER TO MAKE KIMCHI THE TRADITIONAL WAY. PIC HAS STOPPED SERVING KIMCHI UNTIL APPROVAL OF HACCP PLAN.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Dead or Trapped Pest Removed
violations.observation: Multiple dead or trapped cockroaches were found on the premises on sticky glue traps.
violations.corrective_action: Remove dead rodents, birds, and insects from the premises to ensure that the establishment is clean and sanitary and to prevent carcasses from attracting other pests. MULTIPLE STICKY GLUE TRAPS FOR COCKROACHES HAD BEEN PLACED AROUND THE FACILITY. PIC THREW AWAY STICKY PADS WITH DEAD COCKROACHES ON THEM.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: cutting knives were being stored in between the Traulsen 2DR prep top and a prep table, which can not be washed, rinsed and sanitized.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. PIC NOW UNDERSTANDS THAT UTENSILS CAN NEVER BE STORED SOMEWHERE THAT CAN NOT BE WASHED, RINSED AND SANITIZED. PIC REMOVED THE KNIVES TO GET PROPERLY WASHED. JU MAK JIP (Inspection Date: 09/15/2025) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equip/Washer/Dryer/Cabinet Location Prevents Contamination
violations.observation: The clothes (washer/dryer) is located directly next to the 3 vat sink, where it is exposed to contamination.
violations.corrective_action: If a mechanical clothes washer or dryer is provided it shall be located so that the washer or dryer is protected from contamination and only where there is no exposed food, clean equipment, utensils, clean linens, and single-service items. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC THAT THE WASHER AND DRYER ARE NOT ALLOWED TO BE STORED AND USED IN AN AREA WHERE FOOD PREPARATION OCCURS. EHD TOLD PIC THEY MUST MOVE THE WASHER AND DRYER TO A LOCATION PROTECTED FROM CONTAMINATION BY NEXT INSPECTION.

violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. PIC CLEARED HANDSINK.
